# arcane

**Tag**: widgets, user-interface, design, components, shadcn-ui, mobile, ui

## 简介

A modified variant of shadcn_flutter along with new features & improvements. This package follows the changes of shadcn_flutter while also maintaining additional features & fixes.

- 主页: https://arcane.art
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ArcaneArts/arcane
- 文档: https://tome.arcane.art
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/arcane
